construction: Real DJHangarOperation target compilation, PreparedFlyToCommand, H2/MyBatis journal, MessageUtils and existing DJI processor, receipt controller and WebConfig HTTP converter. External publisher records only; input messages, resource facts and authorization are synthetic. No business Spring application, external database, live MQTT or device calls.
copy_change: Added one trailing LF; all original bytes otherwise unchanged, verified by byte comparison.
limitations: This is a synthetic device-reported completion, not real flight or measured displacement.
The production HTTP authorization policy still denies distance flight; the positive execution path starts from a package-private verified test value.
H2 MySQL mode does not validate the deployed MySQL server or transaction wiring.
The loopback smoke separately labels rebound identities, times and synthetic writable permissions; it does not modify this raw fixture.
